sections.body: Let's name body parts: head, shoulders, knees and toes! Eyes, ears, mouth and nose!
If anyone touches you in a way that feels wrong, or asks you to keep a secret that feels bad, tell a grown-up you trust.
You will never be in trouble for telling.
Use correct names for all body parts and agree on who your child's trusted adults are. Explain the difference between surprises (fun, shared soon) and secrets (never OK to keep about touching).
